home.title: Welcome to Folio
home.body: Add your first instrument to start tracking your portfolio.

holdings.title: No holdings yet
holdings.body: Add your first instrument and a transaction to see positions here.

transactions.title: No transactions yet
transactions.body: Add a transaction or import a CSV export from your broker.

dashboards.title: No dashboards yet
dashboards.body: Dashboards arrive in a later phase. You will build them from widgets by drag and drop.

insights.title: Nothing to review
insights.body: Recommendations and alerts will land here.

news.title: No news yet
news.body: Add news sources in Settings once the news feature is available.

strategies.title: No strategy yet
strategies.body: Define your sleeves, targets and rules once the strategy editor is available.

watchlist.title: Watchlist is empty
watchlist.body: Track instruments you do not hold.

reports.title: No reports yet
reports.body: Annual and tax-support reports appear once you have transactions.

system.title: System
system.body: Job runs, provider usage and agent costs will be shown here.

empty.comingLater: This part of Folio is built in a later phase.

login.title: Sign in
login.code: Code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code
login.codeNeeded: Enter the code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.

twofactor.title: Two-factor sign-in
twofactor.intro: With this on, signing in needs your password and a six-digit code from an authenticator app on your phone (Aegis, 2FAS, Google Authenticator, 1Password). Recovery codes let you in if you lose the phone.
twofactor.scan: Scan this with your authenticator app
twofactor.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
twofactor.orType: Or type this key into the app:
twofactor.codeFromApp: The six-digit code the app now shows
twofactor.manageHelp: To turn it off, or to make new recovery codes, enter your password and a current code (or a recovery code).
twofactor.codeOrRecovery: A code from the app, or a recovery code
twofactor.codesHelp: Keep these somewhere safe and apart from your phone, such as a password manager or a printout. Each works once. They are shown only now.
twofactor.fileHeader: Folio recovery codes. Each works once.

owner.intro: Create the single owner account. A long passphrase works best.

preferences.intro: Choose your timezone and number format.

account.intro: Add the broker account you want to track. You can add more later.
account.name: Account name

providers.intro: Optional. Folio works on free tiers; add keys here if you have them. Keys are stored encrypted.

notifications.intro: Optional. Choose how important alerts reach your phone.

settings.title: Settings
settings.secretSet: A value is saved. Type a new one to replace it.
settings.invalidJson: This field must be valid JSON.

fields.risk_free_source: Risk-free rate for the Sharpe ratio
fields.app_url: Folio address for links in pushes (e.g. https://folio.your-tailnet.ts.net)
fields.earnings_days: How far ahead to ask for (days)
fields.unlinked_per_day: Stories linked to nothing to read per day
fields.escalate_impact: Re-assess with the stronger model from impact
fields.escalate_weight_pct: ...or when a position is above this share (%)
fields.event_impact: Start an agent run from impact
fields.news_share_eur: Share of the budget news may use (EUR)
fields.prices: Model prices, US dollars per million tokens (JSON)
fields.usd_per_eur_fallback: Dollars per euro when no ECB rate is stored
